2. Could these be UART pins?

Possibly, but the photograph alone cannot establish that.

I would not connect your USB-UART adapter directly to these contacts yet.

3. How to identify their actual functions

We can investigate them with your multimeter.

Test A – Ground identification

  1. Disconnect the 12 V supply.

  2. Set your multimeter to continuity mode.

  3. Put one probe on a known PCB ground point.

  4. Carefully test each gold contact.

  5. Record which contacts have continuity to ground.

Test B – Voltage identification

After identifying ground:

  1. Power the board normally.

  2. Set the multimeter to DC voltage.

  3. Measure each contact relative to ground.

  4. Record the voltage.

Do not short adjacent contacts while measuring.
